body:
AUDIT-7 Lane 4 closure-review pointers (2026-11-25):

- **#3762 / PR #7678:** PR #7678 closes #3762 while its body explicitly leaves the web documents panel and web contract tests incomplete. No later panel PR was found. Follow-up #14923 / task 23718 now tracks that web-only remainder.
- **#5610 / PR #7679:** PR #7679 implements the retirement gate only. Its own completion note says #5610 stays open for #5768 and the #3232 receipt-validation audit, but the issue state closed at the same merge time. #5768 later landed via PR #7631; #3232 later closed as superseded by PR #5576. Lane 2 should reconcile whether the original #5610 acceptance is satisfied or its closure needs correction.

No issue was reopened by Lane 4.
